name: South Korean Foreigner Registration Number (FRN)
description:
Detects Korean Foreigner Registration Numbers (외국인등록번호) with checksum validation. Same structure as RRN but gender digit is 5-8 (indicating foreign national).

Validator: Weighted sum modulo checksum (same as RRN)
Format: 6 digits (YYMMDD) + dash + gender digit (5-8) + 6 digits
Official name: 외국인등록번호 (Foreigner Registration Number)
Note: PIPA (Personal Information Protection Act) requires strict handling

effect.message: Korean FRN redacted per PIPA (Personal Information Protection Act)
